evidence.reason: After edit, `const value = ...; return v;` references undefined `v` instead of `value`, producing a compile/runtime error and breaking the return contract.
After edit, `priorities` is reordered from `[multiplier, multiplier/2]` to `[multiplier/2, multiplier]`, changing `priorities[0]` and thus the computed charge for every caller.
`subscriptionCharge` value-references `chargeUnit`, which is tied to `usageCharge`; the reordered priorities propagate into subscription billing results.
Tests assert `subscriptionCharge(40) > 0` and `usageQuote(...).amount > 0`; the undefined `v` in subscriptionCharge will fail these assertions.

result.userExplanation: 左侧改动把结果赋给 value 却返回未定义的 v，会导致编译/运行错误，同时右侧改动调换了优先级顺序改变了计费结果，二者合并破坏了原有行为。
result.suggestedAction: 请修改 src/subscription.ts#subscriptionCharge，将 `return v;` 改为 `return value;`；并确认 src/metering.ts#usageCharge 中 priorities 顺序是否应保持 `[multiplier, multiplier/2]`，若需变更请同步更新测试与调用方。
